# Contract: Cumulative Action

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55 | Date: 2026-01-26 -->

## Overview

Generates cross-phase cumulative report combining all sessions for a feature branch (FR-017).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `-Action` | string | Yes | - | Must be "Cumulative" |
| `-FeatureBranch` | string | No | Current branch | Feature branch to aggregate |

## Behavior

1. Load all archives with matching `featureBranch`
2. Include current active session if same branch
3. Aggregate metrics across all phases:
   - Total invocations across all phases
   - Total tokens (sum across phases)
   - Breakdown by phase
   - Combined model distribution
   - Combined category distribution
   - Combined parallelization metrics
4. Display comprehensive feature-level report

## Preconditions

- At least one session with matching feature branch

## Postconditions

- Report displayed (not persisted)

## Example

```powershell
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Cumulative -FeatureBranch "001-agent-metrics-enhancement"
```

## Error Handling

| Error | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| No matching sessions | Exit with "No sessions found for branch: {name}" |
| Git branch detection fails | Exit with "Specify -FeatureBranch parameter" |
